As **link GDMK** rocks back and forth, it drives **slider S** along its guide through **link SMT** while simultaneously moving **link TU** vertically through pin **K** riding in a slot. The input motion causes **link TU** to achieve a straight-line translation of 8.95 cm back and forth.

useCases.why: The linear actuator drive provides controlled lifting and lowering strokes via a rocking lever.

terms.meaning: motion where every point of a body moves along parallel straight paths without rotation
a device that creates motion in a straight line from a rotating or fluid power input

170b0bb0dd774a1bdffa1f218c7e.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, the driven input **AB** turns continuously in full revolutions and drives the coupler **BCD**. The motion continues through **DE** and **EF** to rock the bell crank **FCG** back and forth through an angle of 45.8 deg about ground G. Within this motion, one direction takes 3.58 s and the return takes 2.42 s, resulting in a time ratio of 1.48.

useCases.why: It provides a unequal time ratio between forward and return strokes for efficient cycle timing.

terms.meaning: A pivoting lever with two arms meeting at an angle to change force direction.
The ratio of the time taken for the return stroke to the forward stroke.

17c333abc9161a19c8832ed5052f.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, continuous rotation from the input crank **UV** drives a connecting coupler **TU**, which in turn causes the rocker **GT** to oscillate back and forth through an angle of 40.9 degrees about the ground pivot **G**. The shortest link **UV** rotates fully while the opposite side rocks, creating a continuous cyclic motion.

useCases.why: It converts continuous motor rotation into the oscillating motion needed to sweep a blade back and forth.

terms.meaning: To swing back and forth repeatedly between two points.
Turning in a complete circle endlessly in one direction.

18371d1ee989731445933bd221c1.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, the driven input is **cylinder A-D**, which extends and retracts to push **link DGHIJ ("Carriage")** back and forth in straight-line translation. As **link DGHIJ ("Carriage")** moves horizontally, it swings the connecting couplers **link GM**, **link HQ**, **link IT**, and **link JV**. These couplers drive **link MQS ("Jaw")** and **link TVX ("Jaw")**, causing both jaws to translate vertically in opposite directions with a stroke of 0.69 cm.

useCases.why: It uses synchronized straight-line jaw translation driven by a linear actuator to clamp and release objects.

terms.meaning: motion in a single linear direction without any rotation.
an ungrounded link that connects other moving links to transmit motion.
a device that creates motion in a straight line from a power source.

18633638d792d51ccc113080244a.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, joint W drives **link WX** back and forth to act as an input rocker. **Link WX** pushes **link XY**, which serves as a coupler and swings through general plane motion. This motion drives **link YZ** as a rocker, which oscillates about ground Z through 109.7 deg. Every part moves back and forth over a cycle time of 14.73 s.

useCases.why: It rocks multiple slats back and forth through a limited angular range.
It converts a reciprocating input into an oscillating output stroke.

terms.meaning: A driven link that oscillates back and forth instead of rotating fully.
Combined translation and rotation in a two-dimensional plane.

187399b2e438600353d1146c9d70.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, the driven input link **CP** rocks back and forth and drives link **OA** and link **OB**. These rockers push the four equal links **AP**, **BP**, **AQ**, and **BQ**, which form a rhombus that guides traced point **Q** along a straight line of length 11.58.

useCases.why: It translates rotational motion into a precise straight-line path without sliding guides.

terms.meaning: A four-sided polygon with all sides of equal length.
A point on a link whose path is tracked during motion.

18e7d110ab00dc1a81a9c145aa38.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, the driven input turns **AB** back and forth through an angle of 309 deg. This motion is transmitted through **BC** to swing **CDL** about fixed pivot D. As the input reverses, **CDL** rocks through an angle of 73.2 deg, completing one full back-and-forth cycle in 6.44 s while carrying force F1.

useCases.why: It transforms a continuous or reversing input into an oscillating output swing suitable for sweeping an arc.

terms.meaning: The power source or driving force that initiates motion in the mechanism.
Swinging back and forth repeatedly between two limits.

1a679195bfa20b12c3a2139a26ec.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, the driven input link HI rocks back and forth to move the linkage. Four equal links form a rhombus with parallel sides that constrain point L on link JL to trace a straight line of length 11.58 without riding a guide. Rockers like link GJ and link GK pivot on the ground to support the structure while couplers transfer motion through general plane motion.

useCases.why: It translates rotational movement into an exact straight-line output without sliding tracks.
It provides unguided linear guidance from a pivoting driver.

terms.meaning: A four-sided polygon with all sides of equal length.
Combined translation and rotation in a two-dimensional plane.
A linkage that converts circular motion into exact straight-line motion.

1bb78288ed6cb415bc5e2fe63956.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, the driven input turns **link AB** full revolutions about ground joint A. As it rotates, **pin B** slides back and forth within the slot on **link CD**, causing **link CD** to rock back and forth about ground pivot C through an angle of 38.9 deg. This rocking motion drives **slider R** along a fixed guide through **link DR**, producing a linear reciprocating stroke of length 3.33.

useCases.why: It provides a slow cutting stroke and a fast return stroke to improve machining efficiency.

terms.meaning: A repetitive linear back and forth motion along a straight path.
An oscillating rotational movement back and forth between two limits.

1be32216c7d7050c856a5998fa3e.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, joint Q turns link QRS relative to link PQ at 12 rpm counterclockwise, driving the linked parts through a reversing cycle that takes 1.67 s. As the input rocks, link OP oscillates about ground O while link PQ swings back and forth. The motion transfers through link QRS, which pivots about ground R to rock its opposite end. Finally, connecting rod link ST pushes slider T back and forth over a travel length of 2.09 along a fixed guide at 90 deg.

useCases.why: The rocking beam drives linear motion at the output slider.
A pivoting lever translates rotational input into linear reciprocating stroke output.

terms.meaning: swings back and forth repeatedly around a central pivot
moving alternately back and forth in a straight line

1c8cba313c71d810e6d9149d5b52.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, joint A turns **link AB ("Input crank")** as the driven input to drive **link BCX ("Tool carrier")**, which acts as a coupler and swings back and forth through 39 deg. This motion causes **link CD ("Return rocker")** to rock about ground D, while **link EF ("Loaded output")** rocks about ground E through 20.5 deg. At the same time, pin F slides back and forth by 1.97 within the slot on link BCX ("Tool carrier").

useCases.why: It converts continuous rotary input into reciprocating output motion with varying stroke timing.

terms.meaning: The power source or force applied to make the mechanism move.
A link connecting other moving links without having a fixed pivot to the ground.
Combined translation and rotation motion in a two-dimensional plane.

1ca6bae964393e12f276b4f07972.plainEnglish: This mechanism operates by using joint **I** to drive **link IJ** in full revolutions at 10 rpm counterclockwise. This motion pushes **link JK**, which acts as a coupler and drives **link KL** to rotate fully about ground **L** with an angular speed ranging from 30.6 to 130.5 deg/s. The arrangement forms a Grashof double-crank where the shortest link is the ground, allowing both side cranks to complete full continuous rotations.

useCases.why: It transmits continuous rotational motion from one shaft to another while varying output speed.

terms.meaning: A four-bar linkage where the shortest link is fixed as the ground, enabling both input and output cranks to rotate fully.
A moving link in a mechanism that connects driver and follower links without having a fixed pivot.

1cb72a5944e8711f4ad907ba08e9.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, the linear actuator **cylinder I-E** acts as the driven input, extending and retracting between lengths of 1.39 and 2.31 to push **link EJG**. This bell crank rocks about **ground** pivot J and drives **link HG**, which in turn swings the rocker **link ABHKLMNOPQ** about **ground** pivot A through 84.7 degrees. Point B on this rocker traces a curved path as the mechanism cycles back and forth.

useCases.why: It uses a hydraulic cylinder and bell crank linkage to swing a wheel assembly between extended and stowed positions inside a wing.

terms.meaning: A device that creates motion in a straight line.
A pivoting double-armed lever used to change the direction of motion.
A link that oscillates back and forth about a fixed pivot.

1cc6c7b55b39a114e66754991d5b.plainEnglish: The driven input turns **link AB** in full revolutions, which drives **slider C** back and forth along a fixed guide through connecting rod **link BC**. The guide is offset 1.19 from the crank's pivot, causing **slider C** to travel a distance of 5.33 with a time ratio of 1.22 between its strokes.

useCases.why: It converts rotary motor input into linear piston motion inside a cylinder.
It translates the linear motion of a piston into the rotational output of a crankshaft.

terms.meaning: A link that transfers motion between a rotating crank and a reciprocating part.
The ratio of the time taken for the forward stroke to the return stroke.

1d05070fa557c70b22a68b17c234.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, joint P turns link PSH relative to link MP at 3 rpm clockwise to serve as the driven input. Link MP swings back and forth through 28.5 deg, driving link AM to rock about ground A through 155.2 deg. Meanwhile, link PSH rocks about ground S through 37.8 deg, moving its opposite end H to drive connecting rod link HR. This pushes slider R back and forth along a fixed guide by a distance of 2.09.

useCases.why: It uses a rocking beam to translate rotational input into linear reciprocating motion for lifting operations.

terms.meaning: Motion combining both translation and rotation in a two-dimensional plane.
Repetitive backward and forward linear motion.

1f29423292853108978a7e1861b4.plainEnglish: In this mechanism, the continuous rotation of input **link AB** drives two connected loops to produce oscillating motion. As **link AB** turns, it pushes **link BC** to rock the bell crank **link CDE** through 61 deg. This bell crank then pushes **link EF** to make **link FG** rock back and forth through 42.3 deg. The first loop acts as a crank-rocker, while the second loop functions as a triple-rocker mechanism.

useCases.why: It uses multi-bar linkages to translate continuous motor rotation into precisely timed rocking outputs for tooling.

terms.meaning: A pivoting lever with two arms meeting at an angle to change the direction of motion.
A four-bar linkage where the input rotates fully while the output oscillates back and forth.

1f47a670b01970114dc57515aa62.plainEnglish: This mechanism operates when the input crank **link IJ** rotates continuously about ground pivot **I**, driving two four-bar loops that articulate **link KLM** and **link KN** as rockers. These connected links move couplers **link JL**, **link JN**, **link MO**, and **link NOP** in general plane motion. Consequently, traced point **P** on **link NOP** follows a smooth closed curve, featuring a nearly straight stretch measuring 40.37 cm that accounts for 28% of the cycle.

useCases.why: It converts rotational motion into a foot-like path with a long straight stride for smooth locomotion.

terms.meaning: Motion combining both translation and rotation in a two-dimensional plane.
Links that swing back and forth through a limited angular range.
Links without a fixed pivot that connect input and output members.
